<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { Azeret_Mono, Manrope, Oxanium } from "next/font/google";
import "./volume-zero/volume-zero.css";

const display = Oxanium({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["500", "600", "700"],
  variable: "--font-oxanium",
  display: "swap",
});

const body = Manrope({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600", "700"],
  variable: "--font-manrope",
  display: "swap",
});

const mono = Azeret_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500"],
  variable: "--font-azeret-mono",
  display: "swap",
  preload: false,
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "VOLUME ZERO — Acoustic architecture for rooms that listen back",
  description: "A scroll-driven acoustic chamber for VOLUME ZERO, a fictional acoustic-architecture studio.",
  openGraph: {
    title: "VOLUME ZERO — Tune the silence between sounds",
    description: "A live acoustic chamber for rooms that let sound arrive whole.",
    type: "website",
  },
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: "#171B20",
  colorScheme: "dark",
  width: "device-width",
  initialScale: 1,
};

export default function VolumeZeroLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`} suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}[data-reveal] *{visibility:visible!important}`}</style>
        </noscript>
      </head>
      <body className="vz-body">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/volume-zero";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className }: { assetKey: string; alt: string; className?: string }) {
  const src = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!src) {
    return <div className={`vz-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}><span>{assetKey}</span></div>;
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  // The asset pipeline owns these dimensions and emits responsive variants.
  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
  return <img className={className} src={src} width={w} height={h} alt={alt} loading="lazy" decoding="async" />;
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { ImageResponse } from "next/og";

const INK = "#171B20";

            <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 13, color: ACCENT, letterSpacing: "0.15em" }}>ROOM 04 / LISTENER 07</div>

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-ink: #171B20;
  --color-paper: #F1EEE5;
  --color-accent: #2B9BAA;
  --font-display: var(--font-oxanium), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-manrope), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-azeret-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.35 8%, 0.82 20%, 1.06 30%, 1.02 42%, 0.99 58%, 1);
  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 420ms;
  --dur-slow: 800ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;
  --reveal-shift: 28px;
  --stagger: 70ms;
}

:root {
  --vz-progress: 0;
  --vz-header-h: 78px;
  --vz-gutter: clamp(18px, 5vw, 76px);
  --color-ink: #171B20;
  --color-paper: #F1EEE5;
  --color-accent: #2B9BAA;
  --font-display: var(--font-oxanium), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-manrope), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-azeret-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.35 8%, 0.82 20%, 1.06 30%, 1.02 42%, 0.99 58%, 1);
  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 420ms;
  --dur-slow: 800ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;
  --reveal-shift: 28px;
  --stagger: 70ms;
  --vz-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 18%, transparent);
  --vz-line-light: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper) 20%, transparent);
  --vz-muted: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 62%, var(--color-paper));
  --vz-dark-muted: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper) 62%, var(--color-ink));
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; background: var(--color-paper); }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; }
body, button, input, textarea, select { font-synthesis: none; }
button, input, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
button { border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

.vz-body { overflow-x: clip; }
.vz-shell { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.vz-main { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.vz-wrap { width: min(1320px, 100%); margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--vz-gutter); }
.vz-skip { position: fixed; z-index: 20; top: 10px; left: 10px; transform: translateY(-160%); padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-ink); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-skip:focus { transform: none; }
.vz-progress { position: fixed; z-index: 15; top: 0; left: 0; width: calc(var(--vz-progress) * 100%); height: 3px; transform-origin: left; background: var(--color-accent); pointer-events: none; }

/* Header */
.vz-header { position: fixed; z-index: 10; inset: 0 0 auto; height: var(--vz-header-h); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 14%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper) 92%, transparent); transition: height var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), background var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-header[data-state="compact"] { height: 58px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper) 78%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.vz-header[data-state="hidden"] { transform: translateY(-100%); }
.vz-header__inner { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; }
.vz-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--color-ink); }
.vz-logo__mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: none; }
.vz-logo__type { font: 600 15px/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .12em; }
.vz-logo__type span { color: var(--color-accent); }
.vz-header__nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(16px, 3vw, 42px); margin-left: auto; }
.vz-header__nav a, .vz-header__menu { position: relative; color: var(--vz-muted); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-header__nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -9px; left: 0; height: 2px; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; background: var(--color-accent); transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-header__nav a:hover, .vz-header__nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-ink); }
.vz-header__nav a:hover::after, .vz-header__nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }
.vz-header__readout { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding-left: 18px; border-left: 1px solid var(--vz-line); color: var(--vz-muted); font: 400 10px/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-header__readout strong { color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: 500; }
.vz-header__menu { display: none; padding: 10px 0; background: transparent; }
.vz-header__menu span { display: block; width: 22px; height: 1px; margin: 5px 0; background: currentColor; transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-header__menu[aria-expanded="true"] span:first-child { transform: translateY(3px) rotate(45deg); }
.vz-header__menu[aria-expanded="true"] span:last-child { transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-45deg); }
.vz-header__menu[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }

/* Shared */
.vz-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--color-accent); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 30px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; }
.vz-section-title { max-width: 13ch; margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(2.65rem, 6vw, 6rem)/.94 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.055em; text-wrap: balance; }
.vz-lead { max-width: 42ch; margin: 24px 0 0; color: var(--vz-muted); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.18rem); line-height: 1.65; }
.vz-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-rule { height: 1px; transform-origin: left; background: currentColor; opacity: .22; }
.vz-button { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-ink); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring); }
.vz-button::before { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 0; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; background: var(--color-accent); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-button::after { content: "↗"; color: var(--color-accent); transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-button:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.vz-button:hover, .vz-button:focus-visible { color: var(--color-paper); }
.vz-button:hover::before, .vz-button:focus-visible::before { transform: none; }
.vz-button:hover::after, .vz-button:focus-visible::after { color: var(--color-paper); transform: translate(3px, -3px); }
.vz-button--dark { border-color: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-paper); }
.vz-button--dark::before { background: var(--color-accent); }
.vz-button--fill { border-color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-ink); }
.vz-button--fill::before { background: var(--color-paper); }
.vz-button--fill:hover, .vz-button--fill:focus-visible { color: var(--color-ink); }
.vz-button--fill::after { color: var(--color-ink); }
.vz-button--fill:hover::after, .vz-button--fill:focus-visible::after { color: var(--color-ink); }

/* Hero */
.vz-hero { position: relative; min-height: 100svh; display: grid; align-items: end; overflow: clip; padding: calc(var(--vz-header-h) + 72px) 0 72px; background: var(--color-paper); }
.vz-hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .48; pointer-events: none; background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 45%, transparent 0 64px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 10%, transparent) 65px 66px); transform: scale(1.04); transform-origin: 70% 45%; }
.vz-hero__grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .22; pointer-events: none; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 calc(50% - 1px), var(--color-ink) 50%, transparent calc(50% + 1px)), linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 calc(72% - 1px), var(--color-ink) 72%, transparent calc(72% + 1px)); background-size: 100% 100%; }
.vz-hero__inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(250px, .7fr); gap: 5vw; align-items: end; }
.vz-hero__title { width: 100%; margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(3.2rem, 4.4vw, 5.2rem)/.88 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.07em; text-wrap: balance; }
.vz-hero__title-desktop, .vz-hero__title-mobile { display: block; }
.vz-hero__title-mobile { display: none; }
.vz-hero__title em { color: var(--color-accent); font-style: normal; }
.vz-hero__aside { max-width: 360px; padding-bottom: 8px; }
.vz-hero__aside p { max-width: 32ch; margin: 0; color: var(--vz-muted); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.18rem); line-height: 1.65; }
.vz-hero__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 30px; }
.vz-hero__stamp { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-top: 56px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--vz-line); color: var(--vz-muted); font: 400 10px/1.4 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-hero__stamp strong { color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 500; }
.vz-reveal { --vz-delay: 0ms; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .vz-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--reveal-shift)); transition: opacity var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo), transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo); transition-delay: var(--vz-delay); }
  .vz-reveal[data-in="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  .vz-hero__title .vz-mask { display: block; overflow: clip; }
  .vz-hero__title .vz-mask > span { white-space: nowrap; }
  .vz-hero__title .vz-mask > span { display: block; transform: translateY(110%); animation: vz-hero-rise var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo) forwards; animation-delay: calc(260ms + var(--line) * 120ms); }
  .vz-hero__field { animation: vz-hero-settle var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo) both; }
  .vz-hero__stamp { animation: vz-hero-rule var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out) 720ms both; }
  @keyframes vz-hero-rise { to { transform: none; } }
  @keyframes vz-hero-settle { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.04); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes vz-hero-rule { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
}

/* Chamber */
.vz-chamber { position: relative; min-height: 360svh; background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); }
.vz-chamber__sticky { position: sticky; top: 0; min-height: 100svh; overflow: clip; }
.vz-chamber__canvas-wrap { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color-ink); }
.vz-chamber__canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: .92; }
.vz-chamber__fallback { position: absolute; inset: 8% 5% 12%; width: 90%; height: 80%; opacity: .82; transition: opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.vz-chamber__fallback path, .vz-chamber__fallback line, .vz-chamber__fallback rect { fill: none; stroke: var(--color-accent); stroke-width: 1.2; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.vz-chamber__fallback rect { stroke: var(--color-paper); opacity: .48; }
.vz-chamber__fallback circle { fill: var(--color-accent); }
.vz-chamber__veil { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 68% 47%, transparent 0 16%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 0%, transparent) 42%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 38%, transparent) 100%); }
.vz-chamber__hud { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, .9fr) minmax(280px, .75fr); gap: 6vw; align-items: end; min-height: 100svh; padding: calc(var(--vz-header-h) + 50px) var(--vz-gutter) 46px; pointer-events: none; }
.vz-chamber__hud > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.vz-chamber__copy { max-width: 420px; }
.vz-chamber__copy .vz-eyebrow { color: var(--color-accent); }
.vz-chamber__copy h2 { margin: 0; max-width: 9ch; font: 600 clamp(2.8rem, 6.5vw, 6.5rem)/.9 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.065em; }
.vz-chamber__copy p { max-width: 34ch; margin: 22px 0 0; color: var(--vz-dark-muted); }
.vz-chamber__panel { justify-self: end; width: min(100%, 390px); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--vz-line-light); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 74%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
.vz-chamber__panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vz-line-light); color: var(--vz-dark-muted); font: 400 10px/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-chamber__panel-head strong { color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: 500; }
.vz-chamber__readout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 0; }
.vz-chamber__readout span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; color: var(--vz-dark-muted); font: 400 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-chamber__readout strong { display: block; color: var(--color-paper); font: 600 clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.2rem)/.95 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.05em; }
.vz-chamber__control { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--vz-line-light); }
.vz-chamber__control label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--vz-dark-muted); font: 400 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.vz-chamber__control output { color: var(--color-accent); }
.vz-range { width: 100%; height: 22px; margin: 0; appearance: none; background: transparent; cursor: ew-resize; }

.vz-placeholder { display: grid; min-height: 260px; place-items: center; border: 1px dashed var(--vz-line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper) 80%, var(--color-ink)); color: var(--vz-muted); font: 400 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

<![CDATA[type MarkProps = { className?: string; title?: string };

export function Mark({ className, title }: MarkProps) {
  return (
    <svg
      className={className}
      viewBox="0 0 64 64"
      fill="none"
      role={title ? "img" : undefined}
      aria-label={title}
      aria-hidden={title ? undefined : true}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    >
      <path d="M32 3 56 17v30L32 61 8 47V17z" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" />
      <path d="M32 11 49 21v22L32 53 15 43V21z" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1" opacity=".45" />
      <path d="M32 18v28M18 26l28 14M46 26 18 40" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity=".7" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="5" fill="var(--color-accent)" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="1.8" fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export function Logo({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={`vz-logo ${className ?? ""}`}>
      <Mark className="vz-logo__mark" title="VOLUME ZERO mark" />
      <span className="vz-logo__type">
        VOLUME<span> ZERO</span>
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import type { Object3D } from "three";
import { cameraAt, listenerAt, reflectionPoints, type SurfaceId } from "./geometry";

const INK = 0x171b20;
const PAPER = 0xf1eee5;
const ACCENT = 0x2b9baa;

type ChamberCanvasProps = {
  progressRef: React.MutableRefObject<number>;
  listenerRef: React.MutableRefObject<number>;
  surfaceRef: React.MutableRefObject<SurfaceId>;
  active: boolean;
};

type RendererLike = {
  setPixelRatio: (value: number) => void;
  setSize: (width: number, height: number, updateStyle?: boolean) => void;
  render: (scene: import("three").Scene, camera: import("three").PerspectiveCamera) => void;
  dispose?: () => void;
};

export function ChamberCanvas({ progressRef, listenerRef, surfaceRef, active }: ChamberCanvasProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    let disposed = false;
    let frame = 0;
    let renderer: RendererLike | undefined;
    let scene: import("three").Scene | undefined;
    let camera: import("three").PerspectiveCamera | undefined;
    let pulseMaterialNode: import("three").Material | undefined;
    let cleanup: (() => void) | undefined;

    const boot = async () => {
      const THREE = await import("three");
      if (disposed) return;
      scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color(INK);
      camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(38, 1, 0.1, 100);
      camera.position.set(0, 1.9, 10);

      let usingGpu = false;
      try {
        if ("gpu" in navigator) {
          const { WebGPURenderer, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } = await import("three/webgpu");
          const tsl = await import("three/tsl");
          const gpu = new WebGPURenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true });
          await gpu.init();
          renderer = gpu;
          usingGpu = true;
          const pulse = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
          pulse.colorNode = tsl.color(ACCENT).mul(tsl.oscSine(tsl.time.mul(1.8)).mul(0.12).add(0.88));
          pulse.opacity = 0.9;
          pulseMaterialNode = pulse as unknown as import("three").Material;
        }
      } catch {
        renderer = undefined;
      }
      if (!renderer) renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true });
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.8));
      renderer.setSize(canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth, canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight, false);
      canvas.dataset.backend = usingGpu ? "webgpu" : "webgl2";

      const room = new THREE.Group();
      const roomEdges = new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(8, 4, 6)), new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: PAPER, transparent: true, opacity: 0.33 }));
      roomEdges.position.y = 1.4;
      room.add(roomEdges);
      const floor = new THREE.GridHelper(8, 16, PAPER, PAPER);
      floor.position.y = -0.6;
      floor.material.transparent = true;
      floor.material.opacity = 0.13;
      room.add(floor);
      scene.add(room);

      const source = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 16, 16), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: ACCENT }));
      const listenerMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: PAPER });
      const listener = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.075, 16, 16), listenerMaterial);
      scene.add(source, listener);
      const pulseMaterialFallback = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: ACCENT, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, wireframe: true });
      const pulse = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.26, 16, 12), pulseMaterialFallback) as import("three").Mesh<import("three").BufferGeometry, import("three").Material>;
      if (pulseMaterialNode) pulse.material = pulseMaterialNode;
      scene!.add(pulse);

      const lines = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => {
        const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: ACCENT, transparent: true, opacity: 0.58 }));
        scene!.add(line);
        return line;
      });

      const resize = () => {
        if (!canvas || !camera || !renderer) return;
        const width = canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        camera.aspect = width / Math.max(1, height);
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
      };
      window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
      resize();

      const render = () => {
        if (disposed) return;
        const progress = progressRef.current;
        const cameraState = cameraAt(progress);
        const listenerPoint = listenerAt(progress, listenerRef.current);
        if (!renderer || !scene || !camera) return;
        camera.position.x = Math.sin(cameraState.yaw) * 4.6;
        camera.position.y = 1.7 + progress * 0.45;
        camera.position.z = 9.5 - progress * 2.5;
        camera.lookAt(0, 1.2, progress * 0.3);
        room.rotation.y = cameraState.yaw * 0.6;
        source.position.set(-2.65, 1.25, -2.2 + progress * 0.4);
        listener.position.set(listenerPoint.x * 2.4, listenerPoint.y + 0.55, listenerPoint.z * 2.4);
        pulse.position.copy(source.position);
        pulse.scale.setScalar(1 + ((Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.002) + 1) * 0.14));
        const points = reflectionPoints(listenerPoint, surfaceRef.current);
        points.forEach((point, index) => {
          const line = lines[index];
          const reflected = new THREE.Vector3(point.x * 2.4, point.y + 0.55, point.z * 2.4);
          line.geometry.dispose();
          line.geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([source.position.clone(), reflected, listener.position.clone()]);
          line.material.opacity = point.strength * 0.66;
          line.visible = true;
        });
        lines.slice(points.length).forEach((line) => { line.visible = false; });
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        frame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
      };
      render();

      cleanup = () => {
        window.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
        cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
        lines.forEach((line) => { line.geometry.dispose(); line.material.dispose(); });
        scene?.traverse((object: Object3D) => {
          const disposable = object as Object3D & { geometry?: { dispose: () => void }; material?: { dispose: () => void } };
          disposable.geometry?.dispose();
          disposable.material?.dispose();
        });
        renderer?.dispose?.();
      };
    };
    const idle: ((callback: () => void, options?: { timeout: number }) => number) | undefined = typeof window.requestIdleCallback === "function" ? window.requestIdleCallback.bind(window) : undefined;
    const idleId = idle ? idle(() => void boot(), { timeout: 1200 }) : window.setTimeout(() => void boot(), 80);
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      if (idle && typeof window.cancelIdleCallback === "function") window.cancelIdleCallback(idleId);
      else window.clearTimeout(idleId);
      cleanup?.();
    };
  }, [active, progressRef, listenerRef, surfaceRef]);

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="vz-chamber__canvas" aria-hidden="true" />;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/chamber/geometry.ts">
<![CDATA[import { clamp01, lerp, smoothstep } from "../motion/math";

export type SurfaceId = "felt" | "slat" | "stone";

export type Surface = {
  id: SurfaceId;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  absorption: number;
  reflections: number;
};

export const SURFACES: Record<SurfaceId, Surface> = {
  felt: { id: "felt", label: "Wool felt", description: "Softens early reflections for spoken word.", absorption: 0.82, reflections: 3 },
  slat: { id: "slat", label: "Oak slat", description: "Keeps detail while spreading the upper field.", absorption: 0.44, reflections: 5 },
  stone: { id: "stone", label: "Honed stone", description: "Returns a hard, bright first reflection.", absorption: 0.18, reflections: 7 },
};

export function surfaceAt(id: SurfaceId): Surface {
  return SURFACES[id];
}

export function cameraAt(progress: number): { depth: number; yaw: number } {
  const t = smoothstep(progress);
  return { depth: t, yaw: lerp(-0.18, 0.18, t) };
}

export function listenerAt(progress: number, offset: number): { x: number; y: number; z: number } {
  const p = clamp01(progress);
  const o = clamp01(offset);
  return {
    x: lerp(-0.75, 0.75, o),
    y: lerp(0.18, 0.42, p),
    z: lerp(-0.65, 0.65, p),
  };
}

export type ReflectionPoint = { x: number; y: number; z: number; strength: number };

export function reflectionPoints(listener: { x: number; y: number; z: number }, surface: SurfaceId): ReflectionPoint[] {
  const count = surfaceAt(surface).reflections;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => {
    const angle = (index / count) * Math.PI * 2;
    const radius = 0.28 + (index % 2) * 0.08;
    return {
      x: listener.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
      y: listener.y + Math.sin(angle * 1.7) * 0.18,
      z: listener.z + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
      strength: 1 - index / (count + 2),
    };
  });
}
]]>
    </file>

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";
import { validateCommission, type CommissionValues } from "./validate-commission";

const initialValues: CommissionValues = { name: "", email: "", room: "", note: "" };

export function CommissionForm() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState(initialValues);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof CommissionValues, string>>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "loading" | "success">("idle");

  const update = (key: keyof CommissionValues, value: string) => setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));

  const submit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const nextErrors = validateCommission(values);
    setErrors(nextErrors);
    if (Object.keys(nextErrors).length) return;
    setStatus("loading");
    window.setTimeout(() => setStatus("success"), 420);
  };

  if (status === "success") {
    return <div className="vz-form vz-form__success" data-vz-success role="status"><span className="vz-form__success-mark" aria-hidden="true">✓</span><h3>Field reserved.</h3><p>Thanks, {values.name.trim()}. Your room brief is queued for the next listening session.</p><a className="vz-button vz-button--dark" href="#top" style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>Return to the field</a></div>;
  }

  return <form className="vz-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
    <div className="vz-form__grid">
      <div className="vz-field"><label htmlFor="vz-name">Your name</label><input id="vz-name" name="name" autoComplete="name" value={values.name} onChange={(event) => update("name", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)} aria-describedby={errors.name ? "vz-name-error" : undefined} placeholder="Mara / studio lead" />{errors.name && <span id="vz-name-error" className="vz-field__error">{errors.name}</span>}</div>
      <div className="vz-field"><label htmlFor="vz-email">Email</label><input id="vz-email" name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" value={values.email} onChange={(event) => update("email", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={errors.email ? "vz-email-error" : undefined} placeholder="mara@studio.example" />{errors.email && <span id="vz-email-error" className="vz-field__error">{errors.email}</span>}</div>
      <div className="vz-field vz-field--wide"><label htmlFor="vz-room">What are we tuning?</label><select id="vz-room" name="room" value={values.room} onChange={(event) => update("room", event.target.value)}><option value="">Choose a room type</option><option value="Listening room">Listening room</option><option value="Theatre or recital hall">Theatre or recital hall</option><option value="Archive or gallery">Archive or gallery</option></select></div>
      <div className="vz-field vz-field--wide"><label htmlFor="vz-note">First note <span aria-hidden="true">/ optional</span></label><textarea id="vz-note" name="note" value={values.note ?? ""} onChange={(event) => update("note", event.target.value)} placeholder="Tell us about the room, the seats, or the sound that should stay." /></div>
    </div>
    <button className="vz-button vz-button--fill vz-form__submit" type="submit" disabled={status === "loading"} aria-busy={status === "loading"}>{status === "loading" ? "Reserving field…" : "Send the brief"}</button>
    <p className="vz-form__status" aria-live="polite">{status === "loading" ? "Calibrating a response…" : "No network request. This is a local template interaction."}</p>
  </form>;
}

    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/forms/validate-commission.ts">
<![CDATA[export type CommissionValues = { name: string; email: string; room: string; note?: string };
export type CommissionErrors = Partial<Record<keyof CommissionValues, string>>;

export function validateCommission(values: CommissionValues): CommissionErrors {
  const errors: CommissionErrors = {};
  if (!values.name.trim()) errors.name = "Name is required.";
  if (!values.email.trim()) errors.email = "Email is required.";
  else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(values.email.trim())) errors.email = "Enter a valid email.";
  return errors;
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export type SectionOffsets = { scrollY: number; top: number; height: number; viewport: number };

export function clamp01(value: number): number {
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value));
}

export function lerp(from: number, to: number, progress: number): number {
  return from + (to - from) * progress;
}

export function smoothstep(value: number): number {
  const t = clamp01(value);
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}

export function progressFromOffsets({ scrollY, top, height, viewport }: SectionOffsets): number {
  const travel = Math.max(1, height - viewport);
  return clamp01((scrollY - top) / travel);
}

export function staggerDelay(index: number, stepMs: number): string {
  return `${Math.max(0, index) * Math.max(0, stepMs)}ms`;
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export function Reveal({ children, className = "", delay = 0, as: Tag = "div" }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; delay?: number; as?: "div" | "span" | "p" | "h2" | "h3" | "article" | "figure" }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      node?.setAttribute("data-in", "true");
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      if (entry?.isIntersecting) {
        node.setAttribute("data-in", "true");
        observer.disconnect();
      }
    }, { threshold: 0.16, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8%" });
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return <Tag ref={ref as never} className={`vz-reveal ${className}`} data-reveal style={{ "--vz-delay": `${delay}ms` } as React.CSSProperties}>{children}</Tag>;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/motion/ScrollProgress.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

export function ScrollProgress() {
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    let last = 0;
    const update = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const max = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
      const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.scrollY / max));
      if (Math.abs(progress - last) > 0.001) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--vz-progress", progress.toString());
        last = progress;
      }
    };
    const onScroll = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(update); };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onScroll);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll); window.removeEventListener("resize", onScroll); if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, []);
  return <span className="vz-progress" aria-hidden="true" />;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/motion/SmoothScroll.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

export function SmoothScroll() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const fine = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)");
    const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    if (!fine.matches || reduce.matches) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let destroy: (() => void) | undefined;
    import("lenis").then(({ default: Lenis }) => {
      if (reduce.matches || !fine.matches) return;
      const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, smoothWheel: true, anchors: true });
      const raf = (time: number) => { lenis.raf(time); frame = requestAnimationFrame(raf); };
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
      destroy = () => { cancelAnimationFrame(frame); lenis.destroy(); };
    });
    return () => destroy?.();
  }, []);
  return null;
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cameraAt, listenerAt, surfaceAt, SURFACES, type SurfaceId } from "../chamber/geometry";
import { ChamberCanvas } from "../chamber/ChamberCanvas";

const flowStops = [
  ["01 / EMIT", "A source pulse enters the measured chamber."],
  ["02 / TRAVEL", "Scroll carries the camera across the room's depth."],
  ["03 / LISTEN", "The listener coordinate reveals early reflections."],
  ["04 / TUNE", "A surface selection rebuilds the field."],
];

export function ChamberSection() {
  const sectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const progressRef = useRef(0);
  const listenerRef = useRef(0.5);
  const surfaceRef = useRef<SurfaceId>("slat");
  const roomRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const listenerReadoutRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const rtRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [surface, setSurface] = useState<SurfaceId>("slat");
  const [listenerOffset, setListenerOffset] = useState(0.5);
  const [canvasActive, setCanvasActive] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fine = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)");
    setCanvasActive(fine.matches);
    let offsets = { top: 0, height: 1 };
    let raf = 0;
    const measure = () => {
      const node = sectionRef.current;
      if (!node) return;
      const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      offsets = { top: rect.top + window.scrollY, height: rect.height };
    };
    const update = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const viewport = window.innerHeight;
      const travel = Math.max(1, offsets.height - viewport);
      const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (window.scrollY - offsets.top) / travel));
      progressRef.current = progress;
      const camera = cameraAt(progress);
      const listener = listenerAt(progress, listenerRef.current);
      sectionRef.current?.style.setProperty("--vz-chamber-progress", progress.toString());
      if (roomRef.current) roomRef.current.textContent = `ROOM ${String(4 + Math.round(progress * 3)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      if (listenerReadoutRef.current) listenerReadoutRef.current.textContent = `LISTENER ${String(7 + Math.round(listener.x * 2 + progress * 8)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      if (rtRef.current) rtRef.current.textContent = `RT60 ${(0.48 + (1 - surfaceAt(surfaceRef.current).absorption) * 0.78 + progress * 0.12).toFixed(2)} S`;
      sectionRef.current?.style.setProperty("--vz-camera-depth", camera.depth.toFixed(3));
    };
    const onScroll = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(update); };
    measure(); update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => { measure(); onScroll(); });
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll); if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, []);

  const chooseSurface = (next: SurfaceId) => {
    surfaceRef.current = next;
    setSurface(next);
  };

  const onListenerChange = (value: number) => {
    listenerRef.current = value;
    setListenerOffset(value);
  };

  return (
    <section id="chamber" ref={sectionRef} className="vz-chamber" aria-labelledby="vz-chamber-title">
      <div className="vz-chamber__sticky">
        <div className="vz-chamber__canvas-wrap" onPointerDown={() => setCanvasActive(true)}>
          <ChamberCanvas progressRef={progressRef} listenerRef={listenerRef} surfaceRef={surfaceRef} active={canvasActive} />
          <svg className="vz-chamber__fallback" viewBox="0 0 900 560" role="img" aria-label="Static acoustic chamber diagram">
            <path d="M120 440 170 100 730 100 780 440Z" />
            <path d="M190 410 225 150 675 150 710 410Z" opacity=".5" />
            <line x1="160" y1="300" x2="720" y2="300" opacity=".3" />
            <path d="M190 360Q330 180 450 290T710 360" />
            <path d="M190 360Q340 460 450 290T710 360" opacity=".55" />
            <circle cx="220" cy="360" r="9" /><circle cx="650" cy="315" r="7" />
          </svg>
          <div className="vz-chamber__veil" aria-hidden="true" />
        </div>
        <div className="vz-chamber__hud">
          <div className="vz-chamber__copy">
            <p className="vz-eyebrow">01 / The chamber</p>
            <h2 id="vz-chamber-title">A room is an instrument.</h2>
            <p>Scroll from source to listener. Watch the first reflection arrive, then tune the surface that gives the room its voice.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="vz-chamber__panel" aria-label="Live chamber controls">
            <div className="vz-chamber__panel-head"><span>Field telemetry</span><strong>GPU / <span aria-live="polite">LIVE</span></strong></div>
            <div className="vz-chamber__readout">
              <div><span>Coordinate</span><strong ref={roomRef}>ROOM 04</strong></div>
              <div><span>Listener</span><strong ref={listenerReadoutRef}>LISTENER 07</strong></div>
              <div><span>Decay</span><strong ref={rtRef}>RT60 0.82 S</strong></div>
              <div><span>Surface</span><strong>{surfaceAt(surface).label}</strong></div>
            </div>
            <div className="vz-chamber__control">
              <label htmlFor="listener-position"><span>Listener position</span><output>{Math.round(listenerOffset * 100)}%</output></label>
              <input id="listener-position" className="vz-range" type="range" min="0" max="1" step=".01" value={listenerOffset} onChange={(event) => onListenerChange(Number(event.target.value))} />
            </div>
            <div className="vz-surfaces" role="tablist" aria-label="Choose chamber surface">
              {(Object.keys(SURFACES) as SurfaceId[]).map((id) => (
                <button key={id} className="vz-surface" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={surface === id} data-active={surface === id} onClick={() => chooseSurface(id)}>
                  <span>{SURFACES[id].label}</span><small>{Math.round(SURFACES[id].absorption * 100)}% absorb</small>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="vz-chamber__chapter"><strong>SCROLL FIELD</strong> / 01—04</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="vz-chamber__flow" aria-label="Chamber steps">
        {flowStops.map(([title, text]) => <article key={title}><p className="vz-eyebrow">{title}</p><p>{text}</p></article>)}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Logo } from "../brand/Logo";
import { ScrollProgress } from "../motion/ScrollProgress";

export function Header() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<"top" | "compact" | "hidden">("top");
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const lastY = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (raf) return;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const y = window.scrollY;
        const direction = y > lastY.current ? "down" : "up";
        setState(y < 72 ? "top" : direction === "down" && y > 180 ? "hidden" : "compact");
        lastY.current = y;
        raf = 0;
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll); if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <ScrollProgress />
      <header className="vz-header" data-state={state} data-menu={menuOpen ? "open" : "closed"}>
        <div className="vz-wrap vz-header__inner">
          <a href="#top" aria-label="VOLUME ZERO home"><Logo /></a>
          <nav className="vz-header__nav" aria-label="Primary navigation">
            <a href="#chamber" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Chamber</a>
            <a href="#surfaces" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Surfaces</a>
            <a href="#rooms" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Rooms</a>
            <a href="#commission" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Commission</a>
          </nav>
          <div className="vz-header__readout" aria-label="Live page readout"><span>FIELD</span><strong>ACTIVE</strong></div>
          <button className="vz-header__menu" type="button" aria-label="Toggle navigation" aria-expanded={menuOpen} onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}>
            <span /><span /><span />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>
    </>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { Logo } from "../brand/Logo";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";

export function Hero() {
  return (
    <section id="top" className="vz-hero" aria-labelledby="vz-hero-title">
      <div className="vz-hero__grid" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="vz-hero__field" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="vz-wrap vz-hero__inner">
        <div>
          <p className="vz-eyebrow">VZ / Acoustic architecture / Rotterdam</p>
          <h1 id="vz-hero-title" className="vz-hero__title">
            <span className="vz-hero__title-desktop">
              <span className="vz-mask"><span style={{ "--line": 0 } as React.CSSProperties}>Rooms that let</span></span>
              <span className="vz-mask"><span style={{ "--line": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>sound arrive <em>whole.</em></span></span>
            </span>
            <span className="vz-hero__title-mobile" aria-hidden="true">
              <span className="vz-mask"><span style={{ "--line": 0 } as React.CSSProperties}>Rooms that</span></span>
              <span className="vz-mask"><span style={{ "--line": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>let sound</span></span>
              <span className="vz-mask"><span style={{ "--line": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>arrive</span></span>
              <span className="vz-mask"><span style={{ "--line": 3 } as React.CSSProperties}><em>whole.</em></span></span>
            </span>
          </h1>
        </div>
        <div className="vz-hero__aside">
          <Reveal delay={520}>
            <p>A room is not a container for sound. It is the instrument that gives the sound its shape.</p>
            <div className="vz-hero__actions">
              <a className="vz-button vz-button--fill" href="#chamber">Enter the chamber</a>
              <a className="vz-button" href="#commission">Commission a room</a>
            </div>
          </Reveal>
          <div className="vz-hero__stamp">
            <span><strong>ROOM 04</strong> / LISTENER 07</span>
            <span>RT60 <strong>0.82 S</strong></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="vz-wrap" aria-hidden="true" style={{ position: "absolute", bottom: 18, left: 0, right: 0 }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", color: "var(--vz-muted)", font: "400 10px/1 var(--font-mono)", letterSpacing: ".12em", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>
          <span>Scroll to map the field</span><Logo className="vz-hero__mini-logo" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/sections/Response.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";

export function Response() {
  return (
    <section className="vz-response" aria-labelledby="vz-response-title">
      <div className="vz-wrap vz-response__layout">
        <div className="vz-response__copy"><p className="vz-eyebrow">04 / Response curve</p><h2 id="vz-response-title" className="vz-section-title">Make the quiet measurable.</h2><Reveal delay={140}><p className="vz-lead">A live room is a set of decisions you can read. Our field notes turn first reflection, decay and seat position into a brief the whole team can share.</p><a className="vz-button" href="#commission" style={{ marginTop: 30 }}>Read the field notes</a></Reveal></div>
        <Reveal className="vz-response__chart" delay={220} as="figure">
          <div className="vz-response__chart-head"><span>Room 04 / oak slat</span><strong>0.82 S</strong></div>
          <svg className="vz-response__svg" viewBox="0 0 640 280" role="img" aria-label="Acoustic decay response curve from 0 to 1.2 seconds">
            <line x1="0" y1="36" x2="640" y2="36" /><line x1="0" y1="106" x2="640" y2="106" /><line x1="0" y1="176" x2="640" y2="176" /><line x1="0" y1="246" x2="640" y2="246" />
            <path pathLength="1" d="M0 36 C36 42 48 68 78 88 S132 118 188 138 S260 164 320 184 S410 207 480 226 S575 240 640 246" />
          </svg>
          <figcaption className="vz-response__legend"><span>source impulse</span><span>first reflection</span><span>field floor</span></figcaption>
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/sections/Rooms.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ROOMS } from "../content/rooms";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";

export function Rooms() {
  return (
    <section id="rooms" className="vz-rooms" aria-labelledby="vz-rooms-title">
      <div className="vz-wrap">
        <div className="vz-rooms__head"><div><p className="vz-eyebrow">03 / Rooms in practice</p><h2 id="vz-rooms-title" className="vz-section-title">Every project starts with a coordinate.</h2></div><p>Three rooms, three listening briefs. We keep the numbers visible so the atmosphere has something to answer to.</p></div>
        <div className="vz-room-list">
          {ROOMS.map((room, index) => <Reveal key={room.code} delay={index * 80} className="vz-room-row" as="article">
            <span className="vz-room-row__code">{room.code}</span>
            <h3>{room.name}</h3>
            <p>{room.summary}<br /><span className="vz-mono">{room.city} / {room.coordinates}</span></p>
            <div className="vz-room-row__spec"><strong>{room.decaySeconds.toFixed(2)} S</strong>{room.seats} seats<br />{room.discipline}</div>
            <span className="vz-room-row__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
          </Reveal>)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(volume-zero)/volume-zero/sections/Surfaces.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { SURFACES, type SurfaceId } from "../chamber/geometry";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";

const surfaceMeta: Array<{ id: SurfaceId; code: string; meta: string }> = [
  { id: "felt", code: "S-01", meta: "82% absorb / 03 paths" },
  { id: "slat", code: "S-04", meta: "44% absorb / 05 paths" },
  { id: "stone", code: "S-07", meta: "18% absorb / 07 paths" },
];

export function Surfaces() {
  return (
    <section id="surfaces" className="vz-surfaces-section" aria-labelledby="vz-surfaces-title">
      <div className="vz-wrap">
        <div className="vz-surfaces-section__head">
          <div><p className="vz-eyebrow">02 / Surface library</p><h2 id="vz-surfaces-title" className="vz-section-title">Materials give the room its accent.</h2></div>
          <p className="vz-lead">Three surfaces, one field. Select a material in the chamber to change absorption, reflection count and the shape of the listening moment.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="vz-surface-grid">
          {surfaceMeta.map((item, index) => {
            const material = SURFACES[item.id];
            return <Reveal key={item.id} delay={index * 80} className="vz-material-card" as="article">
              <div className="vz-material-card__top"><span className="vz-material-card__index">{item.code}</span><span>{material.label}</span></div>
              <div className="vz-material-card__bottom"><h3>{material.label}</h3><p>{material.description}</p><div className="vz-material-card__meta"><span>{item.meta}</span><span>FIELD / READY</span></div></div>
            </Reveal>;
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

class="vz-lead">Three surfaces, one field. class="vz-room-row__code">VZ-01</span><h3>The Listening Room</h3><p>A close field with no dead corners: the listener sits inside the first reflection.<br/><span class="vz-mono">Rotterdam · NL<!-- --> / <!-- -->51.9244° N / 4.4777° E</span></p><div class="vz-room-row__spec"><strong>0.48<!-- --> S</strong>18<!-- --> seats<br/>Private listening</div><span class="vz-room-row__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></article><article class="vz-reveal vz-room-row" data-reveal="true" style="--vz-delay:80ms"><span class="vz-room-row__code">VZ-04</span><h3>The Recital Room</h3><p>Oak slats class="vz-room-row__spec"><strong>0.82<!-- --> S</strong>31<!-- --> seats<br/>Chamber music</div><span class="vz-room-row__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></article><article class="vz-reveal vz-room-row" data-reveal="true" style="--vz-delay:160ms"><span class="vz-room-row__code">VZ-07</span><h3>The Archive Hall</h3><p>A long, quiet volume that lets a single voice stay legible across 24 vz-response__layout"><div class="vz-response__copy"><p class="vz-eyebrow">04 / Response curve</p><h2 id="vz-response-title" class="vz-section-title">Make the quiet measurable.</h2><div We will return a measured field plan, a listening route and a first surface study.</p><div class="vz-commission__notes"><div class="vz-commission__note"><span>Response</span><strong>48 hours</strong></div><div class="vz-commission__note"><span>First field</span><strong>10 working days</strong></div><div class="vz-commission__note"><span>Studio</span><strong>Rotterdam / remote</strong></div></div></div><form class="vz-form" noValidate=""><div class="vz-form__grid"><div class="vz-field"><label for="vz-name">Your name</label><input id="vz-name" autoComplete="name" aria-invalid="false" placeholder="Mara / studio lead" name="name" value=""/></div><div class="vz-field"><label for="vz-email">Email</label><input id="vz-email" type="email" autoComplete="email" aria-invalid="false" placeholder="mara@studio.example" name="email" value=""/></div><div class="vz-field vz-field--wide"><label for="vz-room">What are we tuning?</label><select id="vz-room" name="room"><option value="" selected="">Choose a room type</option><option value="Listening room">Listening room</option><option value="Theatre or recital hall">Theatre or recital hall</option><option value="Archive or gallery">Archive or gallery</option></select></div><div class="vz-field vz-field--wide"><label for="vz-note">First note <span aria-hidden="true">/ optional</span></label><textarea id="vz-note" name="note" placeholder="Tell us about the room, the seats, or the sound that should stay."></textarea></div></div><button class="vz-button vz-button--fill vz-form__submit" type="submit" aria-busy="false">Send the brief</button><p class="vz-form__status" aria-live="polite">No network request.
